description: Header file defining constants, enums, structures, and function-like inline helpers for SDHC (Secure Digital Host Controller) driver in Zephyr OS, including command IDs, response types, error flags, and data structures for SD card info.

methods.name: sdhc_decode_csd
methods.description: Inline function to decode raw CSD register data into structured form, calculating total blocks and block size.

methods.name: sdhc_decode_scr
methods.description: Inline function to decode raw SCR register data into structured form, including version detection.

methods.name: sdhc_decode_cid
methods.description: Inline function to decode raw CID register data into structured form.

methods.name: sdhc_map_r1_status
methods.description: Inline function to convert R1 response status flags into error codes.

methods.name: sdhc_map_disk_status
methods.description: Inline function to convert disk status flags into error codes.
